name: Pete Harckham

sponsored.t: Relates to the qualifications to hold the position of assistant county attorney in the county of Rockland
sponsored.sum: Allows a non-resident to hold the position of assistant county attorney in the county of Rockland.

sponsored.t: Relates to qualifications to hold the positions of village treasurer, deputy village treasurer, village clerk, deputy clerk and building inspector in the village of Briarcliff Manor
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the village of Briarcliff Manor to provide that the positions of village treasurer, deputy village treasurer, village clerk, deputy clerk and building inspector may be held by residents of Westchester county, or an adjoining county within the state of New York.

sponsored.t: Extends the time period for recovery of energy performance contract costs incurred by school districts
sponsored.sum: Extends the time period from eighteen years to twenty-five years that a school shall be guaranteed recovery of energy performance contract costs from energy savings incurred by school districts over that time period.

sponsored.t: Makes all state lands subject to taxation for all purposes
sponsored.sum: Makes all state lands subject to taxation for all purposes.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the taxation of state land in the county of Westchester
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the taxation of state land in the county of Westchester.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the county of Putnam to lease certain lands used as parklands
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the county of Putnam to lease certain lands used as parklands in the town of Carmel for use as a cell tower for thirty years.

sponsored.t: Establishes a school speed zone camera demonstration program in the village of Croton-on-Hudson
sponsored.sum: Establishes a school speed zone camera demonstration program in the village of Croton-on-Hudson; repeals authorization of program December 31, 2031.
sponsored.fis: None to the State. Fiscal impact on the village of Croton-on-Hudson to be determined.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "packaging reduction and recycling infrastructure act"
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "packaging reduction and recycling infrastructure act" to require companies selling, offering for sale, or distributing packaging materials and products to register with a packaging reduction organization to develop a packaging reduction and recycling plan; makes related provisions.

sponsored.t: Expands recycling of electronic products
sponsored.sum: Expands the public education and outreach program required to be developed by manufacturers of electronics and electronic waste collection sites.

sponsored.t: Relates to modifications, suspensions, revocations, and renewals of permits under the air quality control program
sponsored.sum: Enacts provisions relating to modifications, suspensions, revocations, and renewals under the air quality control program; provides for expiration of any permit which has no expiration and has been in effect for five years; provides renewal periods shall not be longer than five years.

sponsored.t: Provides the village of Ossining, Westchester county, with the ability to set restrictions on the hours of sale of alcoholic beverages at retail for on-premises consumption
sponsored.sum: Provides the village of Ossining, Westchester county, with the ability to set restrictions on the hours of sale of alcoholic beverages at retail for on-premises consumption by local law, ordinance, or resolution.

sponsored.t: Establishes the New York road salt reduction council and the New York road salt reduction advisory committee
sponsored.sum: Establishes the New York road salt reduction council and the New York road salt reduction advisory committee to provide a mechanism for interagency cooperation and coordination to implement the recommendations of the report of the Adirondack road salt reduction task force.

sponsored.t: Enacts the restriction of anticoagulant pesticide transactions for online and retail stores act
sponsored.sum: Enacts the restriction of anticoagulant pesticide transactions for online and retail stores act to prohibit any person from selling, offering for sale or use, or distributing within the state, any second-generation anticoagulant rodenticide; prohibits the use of either a first-generation anticoagulant rodenticide or a second-generation anticoagulant rodenticide within five hundred feet of a wildlife habitat area.

sponsored.t: Authorizes funding to local government entities from the urban development corporation
sponsored.sum: Authorizes funding to local government entities from the urban development corporation through the electric generation facility cessation mitigation fund for an additional five years.
sponsored.fis: None to the state, as additional appropriations have already been made to the fund.

sponsored.t: Permits the town of Southeast, Putnam county, to lease certain sports field fences for advertisements
sponsored.sum: Permits the town of Southeast, Putnam county, to lease fences at the John E. Markel Memorial Park for advertisements.
sponsored.fis: Increased revenue for the local government.

sponsored.t: Relates to workplace safety equipment for social services employees
sponsored.sum: Requires every city or county social services district to provide a wearable or mobile phone-based panic button to each employee whose job responsibilities necessitate direct interaction with clients in a client's home.

sponsored.t: Relates to demonstration programs imposing monetary liability on the owner of a vehicle for failure of an operator thereof to comply with certain posted maximum speed limits in the town of Yorktown
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the town of Yorktown, Westchester county, shall have the ability to install and operate photo speed violation monitoring systems within construction or maintenance work areas that fall within the border or jurisdiction of such municipality; makes related provisions.

sponsored.t: Requires utility corporations and municipalities to notify property owners prior to beginning any scheduled non-emergency construction or other work
sponsored.sum: Requires a utility corporation or municipality to notify property owners at least five business days prior to beginning any non-emergency construction or other work that will result in a planned interruption of a customer's property; requires notice to include, but not be limited to, a description of the work to be performed, the expected duration of such work, the location of such work, and the contact information for the utility performing such work; exempts cases where a natural or man-made disaster or state of emergency occurs.

sponsored.t: Relates to limiting audit and review of certain medical assistance program funds
sponsored.sum: Limits the reimbursement amount of certain overpayment claims and reviews where such overpayment was due to the provider's submission of records which were not in accordance with program requirements at the time but which were in accordance with current requirements as a result of changes to guidelines or regulations.

sponsored.t: Authorizes a plaintiff commencing an action alleging conduct constituting a sexual offense or a civil offense involving the transmission of HIV shall have the right to proceed anonymously
sponsored.sum: Authorizes a plaintiff commencing an action alleging conduct constituting a sexual offense or a civil offense involving the transmission of the human immunodeficiency virus shall have the right to proceed anonymously.

sponsored.t: Authorizes Tina Russo to receive certain service credit with the New York state teachers' retirement system
sponsored.sum: Authorizes Tina Russo to receive certain service credit with the New York state teachers' retirement system.

sponsored.t: Relates to the management of PFAS in biosolids
sponsored.sum: Relates to the management of PFAS in biosolids in the state by requiring testing and reporting of certain groundwater, biosolids, and soil and establishing a moratorium on the sale and use of biosolids; establishes the PFAS agricultural response program and fund to assist farms found to have levels of PFAS contamination which exceed regulatory standards.

sponsored.t: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system to Lieutenant Pietro Viviano
sponsored.sum: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system to Lieutenant Pietro Viviano in the town of New Castle, county of Westchester.

sponsored.t: Establishes the Birch Hill-Highview Water District in the town of Southeast, Putnam County
sponsored.sum: Establishes the Birch Hill - Highview Water District in the town of Southeast, Putnam County.

sponsored.t: Authorizes Larry Mendel to receive his 30 years of service credit granting eligibility for the length of service award program
sponsored.sum: Authorizes Larry Mendel to receive his 30 years of service credit granting eligibility for the length of service award program.
sponsored.fis: Fiscal impact to be determined to the town of Patterson.

sponsored.t: Authorizes Breanne M. Smith to receive a refund of certain accumulated contributions paid to the New York state and local employees' retirement system
sponsored.sum: Authorizes Breanne M. Smith to receive a refund of certain accumulated contributions paid to the New York state and local employees' retirement system.

sponsored.t: Establishes a floating solar incentive and education program
sponsored.sum: Directs the New York state energy research and development authority to establish a floating solar incentive and education program to provide information and resources including technical assistance, access to industry standards, and financing available through the authority or other public or private sector sources, to municipalities, developers, builders, design professionals, and potential owners for the construction of floating solar.

sponsored.t: Establishes the nutrient inactivant application permit
sponsored.sum: Establishes the nutrient inactivant application permit to allow for the use of products used for controlling phosphorus levels in lakes or ponds to prevent and inhibit harmful algal blooms.

sponsored.t: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system in the town of Lewisboro, county of Westchester, to Nathaniel Reynolds
sponsored.sum: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system constituting state route thirty-five, beginning at its intersection with state route one hundred twenty-one and continuing to its intersection with North Salem road, in the town of Lewisboro, county of Westchester, to Nathaniel Reynolds.

sponsored.t: Prohibits the use of drilling fluids, brine and flowback water from gas or oil wells, pools, or fields on any highway
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the use of drilling fluids, brine and flowback water from gas or oil wells, pools, or fields on any highway for any purpose including but not limited to de-icing or dust suppression.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "mansion tax adjustment act"
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "mansion tax adjustment act"; increases the sales price threshold for real property conveyances that will trigger additional sales tax.

sponsored.t: Relates to enacting the "traveling with dignity act"
sponsored.sum: Provides for adult changing tables to be placed within an enclosed restroom facility or other similar private facility that is for use by persons with disabilities who need help with diapering at commercial places of public amusement and state-owned buildings open to the public.

sponsored.t: Directs the commissioner of transportation to waive an annual security deposit fee for use of state land
sponsored.sum: Directs the commissioner of transportation to waive the annual security deposit fee specified in Use and Occupancy Permit No. 82771 issued to the Bedford Hills Fire District, Town of Bedford, Westchester County allowing for the use of approximately 4,000 square feet of state land for parking for volunteer firefighter members of the Bedford Hills Fire District.

sponsored.t: Relates to the first responder peer support program act
sponsored.sum: Establishes the "first responder peer support program act" which supplies peer-to-peer mental health programs to first responders.

sponsored.t: Prohibits the breeding, sale, trade, purchase, importation, and exportation of red-eared slider turtles
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the breeding, sale, trade, purchase, importation, and exportation of red-eared slider turtles in the state; exempts certain entities and organizations.

sponsored.t: Waives the residency requirement for the commissioner of health and public health director for Putnam county
sponsored.sum: Waives the residency requirement for the commissioner of health and public health director for Putnam county.

sponsored.t: Provides a tax exemption on certain auxiliary dwelling units constructed for seniors or disabled individuals
sponsored.sum: Allows a real property tax exemption for dwelling units constructed for senior citizens or disabled persons receiving social security disability benefits.

sponsored.t: Relates to the functions of the Medicaid inspector general with respect to audit and review of medical assistance program funds
sponsored.sum: Requires the Medicaid inspector general to comply with standards relating to the audit and review of medical assistance program funds.

sponsored.t: Creates a road salt reduction policies and applicator training program for use by state agencies and state contractors
sponsored.sum: Requires the commissioner of the department of transportation, in consultation with the commissioner of environmental conservation to establish a set of comprehensive road salt reduction policies and to design a road salt applicator training program; requires the department, every state agency and state contractor which uses road salt to use such training materials to train and inform employees on the best practices of using such materials.

sponsored.t: Relates to local block anesthesia certificate
sponsored.sum: Provides that a dental hygienist shall not administer local block anesthesia without a certificate and except under the personal supervision of a dentist and in conjunction with the performance of dental hygiene procedures authorized by law and in accordance with regulations promulgated by the commissioner.

sponsored.t: Adds hazardous air quality to the state definition of a disaster and includes air quality emergency preparedness in local comprehensive emergency management plans
sponsored.sum: Adds hazardous air quality to the state definition of a disaster; requires explicit inclusion of air quality emergency preparedness in local comprehensive emergency management plans with an action plan and annual inventory of air quality emergency resources.

sponsored.t: Relates to winter road maintenance data collection and monitoring
sponsored.sum: Establishes a standardized statewide system for collecting, recording, and monitoring winter road maintenance operational data in order to improve efficiency, enhance transparency, and support the protection of water resources in the state of New York; requires calibration of all deicing material application equipment used for winter highway maintenance on public roads.

sponsored.t: Directs the New York state bridge authority to provide a report outlining their efforts and progress on decreasing and deterring suicide attempts on authority bridges
sponsored.sum: Directs the New York state bridge authority to provide a report by July 1, 2027, outlining their efforts and progress on decreasing and deterring suicide attempts on authority bridges.

sponsored.t: Directs the creation of a document giving certain notice to parents and guardians of school age students who are diagnosed with a life-threatening medical condition or a certain medical condition
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "Shepherd Patterson notification act"; requires a physician who treats a minor patient with a medical condition that may cause a disability to provide certain educational information to such patient's parents or guardians indicating such minor is entitled to a free and appropriate public education as defined under section five hundred four of the federal rehabilitation act of nineteen hundred seventy-three; makes related provisions.

sponsored.t: Directs the commissioner of the division of criminal justice services to study gender disparity in sentencing outcomes
sponsored.sum: Directs the commissioner of the division of criminal justice services to study gender disparity in sentencing outcomes and make a report to the governor and the legislature of their findings, conclusions and recommendations.

sponsored.t: Requires the department of environmental conservation, after consultation with the environmental facilities corporation and the department of state, to submit an annual agency stormwater expenditure report
sponsored.sum: Requires the department of environmental conservation, after consultation with the environmental facilities corporation and the department of state, to submit an annual agency stormwater expenditure report containing a comprehensive estimate and summary of funds needed and funds spent on stormwater projects under the department of environmental conservation, the environmental facilities corporation, the department of state and other applicable agencies or state authorities.

sponsored.t: Adds Doodletown Brook to the definition of inland waterways eligible for the local waterfront revitalization program
sponsored.sum: Adds Doodletown Brook to the definition of inland waterways eligible for the local waterfront revitalization program.

sponsored.t: Relates to setting integrated behavioral health services
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the commissioner of the office of mental health, and the office of addiction services and support to jointly establish a single set of licensing standards and requirements for the construction, operation, reporting and surveillance of integrated behavioral health services.

sponsored.t: Establishes a uniform electronic medical records system for correctional facilities
sponsored.sum: Directs the commissioner of corrections and community supervision, in consultation with the commissioner of health and the commissioner of mental health, to develop a uniform electronic medical records system to be utilized by all correctional facilities in the state.

sponsored.t: Relates to residential solar and energy storage permitting
sponsored.sum: Requires all authorities having jurisdiction over a population exceeding five thousand residents to adopt a residential automated solar permitting platform by June thirtieth, two thousand twenty-seven.

sponsored.t: Relates to carport-mounted solar energy system siting
sponsored.sum: Prohibits local governments from prohibiting the construction, installation, or operation of carport-mounted solar energy systems with a nameplate capacity of five megawatts or less, in any non-residential zoning district or mixed commercial and residential zoning district of any such city, town or village, provided however, if the zoning district is a certified agricultural district the agricultural impacts of the projects shall be minimized to the extent practicable.

sponsored.t: Extends provisions relating to the establishment of the mercury thermostat collection act
sponsored.sum: Extends provisions relating to the establishment of the mercury thermostat collection act to January 1, 2028.

sponsored.t: Establishes a moratorium on the sale and use of biosolids
sponsored.sum: Establishes a moratorium on the sale and use of biosolids; defines terms.

sponsored.t: Provides benefits to Metro-North employees involved in or who witness a serious injury or fatality of another person in the course of an assigned duty
sponsored.sum: Provides benefits to Metro-North employees involved in or who witness a serious injury or fatality of another person in the course of an assigned duty.

sponsored.t: Relates to the construction of facilities for chemical dependence services that promote the privacy of individuals
sponsored.sum: Relates to the construction of facilities for chemical dependence services that promote the privacy of individuals while bathing, sleeping, using restrooms and receiving individual counseling services, while also allowing for maximization of the use of such facility.

sponsored.t: Directs the commissioner of corrections and community supervision to study gender disparity in resources provided to incarcerated individuals
sponsored.sum: Directs the commissioner of corrections and community supervision to study gender disparity in resources provided to incarcerated individuals and make a report to the governor and the legislature of the findings, conclusions and recommendations.

sponsored.t: Directs state agencies to adopt a waste diversion plan
sponsored.sum: Directs state agencies to adopt a waste diversion plan.

sponsored.t: Relates to eligibility for admission to New York state veterans' homes
sponsored.sum: Expands eligibility for admission to New York state veterans' homes to certain veterans who have an immediate family member who shall have been a resident of this state for six months prior to the date of application for admission; defines an immediate family member to include a spouse, or a birth or adoptive parent, child, sibling, stepparent, stepchild, stepsibling, grandparent and grandchild; requires, where applicable, the immediate family member of a veteran applicant to file an affidavit of New York state residence; authorizes veterans with an immediate family member who has been a New York state resident for six months to be entitle to admission to the Long Island state veterans home…
sponsored.fis: There are no fiscal implications associated with the passage of this legislation.

sponsored.t: Authorizes Nigel Barnett to receive certain retirement service credit in the New York state and local police and fire retirement system
sponsored.sum: Authorizes Nigel Barnett to receive certain retirement service credit in the New York state and local police and fire retirement system for service as a correction officer with the county of Dutchess.

sponsored.t: Relates to food service item waste reduction
sponsored.sum: Prohibits public food service establishments operating in the state from providing excess food service items including single-use utensils, condiments, napkins and extra containers, to any customer except upon, and in accordance with, the express request of that customer.

sponsored.t: Relates to the disposition of certain fines and penalties
sponsored.sum: Provides for the disposition of certain fines and penalties; directs such fines to a conservation enforcement account in the state conservation fund.

sponsored.t: Authorizes Mike Hartnett to apply for military service credit in the New York city fire pension fund
sponsored.sum: Authorizes Mike Hartnett to apply for military service credit in the New York city fire pension fund for active duty service in the U.S. Army from July 7, 1964 until July 7, 1967.

sponsored.t: Relates to operators of a vehicle overtaking a bicycle or pedestrian
sponsored.sum: Relates to operators of a vehicle overtaking a bicycle or pedestrian outside the city of New York.

sponsored.t: Directs the commissioner to publicly publish an annual report on the environmental radiation surveillance program
sponsored.sum: Directs the commissioner to publicly publish an annual report on the environmental radiation surveillance program and analyze such report showing trends and cumulative impact, as well as notify other relevant agencies if contamination has exceeded EPA standards for maximum amounts of contamination allowed in drinking water or food.

sponsored.t: Requires utility service providers to disclose planned rate increases to consumers within a certain amount of time
sponsored.sum: Requires utility service providers to disclose planned rate increases to consumers within thirty days before a planned price increase takes effect; requires utility providers to provide contact information and a mechanism to cancel service completely.

sponsored.t: Establishes the 2-1-1 essential community services hotline system
sponsored.sum: Establishes the 2-1-1 essential community services hotline system; designates the office of children and family services to oversee the hotline system; establishes the availability and scope of information to be provided by the hotline system and requirements of call centers; requires the office of children and family services to collect certain data relating to the hotline system and to make annual reports to the governor and the legislature.
sponsored.fis: This 2-1-1 essential community services hotline system will operate with a state appropriation.

sponsored.t: Directing the state board of real property tax services to conduct a study on real property tax saturation
sponsored.sum: Relates to directing the state board of real property tax services to conduct a study on real property tax saturation.

sponsored.t: Establishes a long-duration energy storage procurement target in New York state
sponsored.sum: Establishes a long-duration energy storage procurement target in New York state of three thousand megawatts by December thirty-first, two thousand thirty.
sponsored.fis: To be determined. Any fiscal impact will depend on program design, procurement volumes and timing, and resulting effects on system costs. Program costs and benefits are expected to be considered by the PSC in establishing procurement mechanisms intended to achieve the target at least cost.

sponsored.t: Relates to deer management permits; repealer
sponsored.sum: Provides for the issuance of deer management permits in the northern zone of the state.

sponsored.t: Establishes the authority of the department of environmental conservation to manage Atlantic bonito and false albacore
sponsored.sum: Establishes the authority of the department of environmental conservation to manage Atlantic bonito and false albacore.

sponsored.t: Relates to the definition of tidal wetlands
sponsored.sum: Specifies the marine and coastal district as part of the definition of tidal wetlands.

sponsored.t: Extends provisions of law relating to the taking of sharks
sponsored.sum: Extends provisions of law relating to the taking of sharks.

sponsored.t: Relates to commercial food fish licenses
sponsored.sum: Relates to the issuance of commercial food fish licenses.

sponsored.t: Relates to not requiring prior authorization for certain cancer treatments
sponsored.sum: Relates to not requiring a prior authorization determination for certain categories of cancer treatments based on National Comprehensive Cancer Network Guidelines.

sponsored.t: Provides access to live scan fingerprinting to society for the prevention of cruelty to animals officers
sponsored.sum: Provides access to live scan fingerprinting to society for the prevention of cruelty to animals officers.

sponsored.t: Relates to insurance coverage for pediatric acute-onset neuropsychiatric syndrome
sponsored.sum: Requires health insurance policies to cover costs for pediatric acute-onset neuropsychiatric syndrome rehabilitation treatment.

sponsored.t: Expands the applicability of the assessment exemption for living quarters for parent or grandparent
sponsored.sum: Expands the applicability of the assessment exemption for living quarters for parent or grandparent to include living quarters constructed or reconstructed before the effective date of the section providing such exemption.

sponsored.t: Provides for electronic notice for collateral loan brokers
sponsored.sum: Provides for notice of intention to sell and notice of surplus to be made by e-mail or text message.

sponsored.t: Establishes a time-limited blue ribbon panel on co-occurring disorders to develop a statewide framework for the integration of mental health and substance use services
sponsored.sum: Establishes a time-limited blue ribbon panel on co-occurring disorders to develop a statewide framework for the integration of mental health and substance use services.

sponsored.t: Relates to the completion of training requirements for sheriffs and undersheriffs
sponsored.sum: Relates to the completion of training requirements for sheriffs and undersheriffs; directs the municipal police training council to promulgate rules and regulations relating to qualification for municipal police forces for persons who were previously sworn members of the state police and to provide certificates to such persons who meet such qualifications.

sponsored.t: Relates to reimbursement for non-medical transportation for individuals with a substance use disorder to receive peer support services
sponsored.sum: Relates to reimbursement for non-medical transportation for individuals with a substance use disorder to receive peer support services.

sponsored.t: Requires schools to include instruction on the prevention of co-occurring disorders as an integral part of their health education programs
sponsored.sum: Requires schools to include instruction on the prevention of co-occurring disorders as an integral part of their health education programs.

sponsored.t: Requires certain corporations to annually prepare a climate-related financial risk report for submission to the secretary of state and to make such report available to the public
sponsored.sum: Requires certain corporations authorized to operate in the state and subject to the supervision of the department of financial services that had annual gross revenues of at least five hundred million dollars ($500,000,000) in the prior calendar year to annually prepare a climate-related financial risk report for submission to the secretary of state and to make such report available to the public.

sponsored.t: Requires owners of certain large vessels to establish whale strike prevention policies
sponsored.sum: Requires owners of certain large vessels to establish whale strike prevention policies; establishes penalties for failure to establish such policies.

sponsored.t: Extends certain provisions relating to the repair of damaged pesticide containers
sponsored.sum: Extends certain provisions relating to the repair of damaged pesticide containers.

sponsored.t: Grants retroactive tier V membership in the New York state and local employees' retirement system to Marca McClenon
sponsored.sum: Grants retroactive tier V membership in the New York state and local employees' retirement system to Marca McClenon.

sponsored.t: Relates to authorizing the New York state energy research and development authority to administer a program to provide grants related to enabling switching residences to electric heat pumps
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the New York state energy research and development authority to administer a program to provide grants or loans for the costs related to enabling switching residences with propane or fuel-oil heating systems to efficient electric heat pumps.

sponsored.t: Prohibits fuel oil, grade number four in any building or facility in the state
sponsored.sum: Prohibits fuel oil, grade number four in any building or facility in the state after July 1, 2030.

sponsored.t: Relates to composting facilities in state parks
sponsored.ls: Parks, Recreation and Historic Preservation Law
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the commissioner of parks, recreation and historic preservation to permit composting facilities at state parks when such facility does not harm the natural environment or integrity of the park and provided that such facilities shall comply with codes, rules and regulations relating to composting facilities.

sponsored.t: Enacts the accelerate solar for affordable power (ASAP) act
sponsored.sum: Enacts the accelerate solar for affordable power (ASAP) act to set a new target for distributed solar energy capacity and direct the public service commission to advance reforms to the utility interconnection process to ensure timely and cost-effective integration of new distributed energy resources.

sponsored.t: Relates to the proper collection and disposal of mercury thermostats
sponsored.sum: Relates to the proper collection and disposal of mercury thermostats; establishes a fund for the stewardship of mercury thermostats; extends the effectiveness of the mercury thermostat collection act.
sponsored.fis: None to the State of New York

sponsored.t: Directs the public service commission to create an agrivoltaics incentive program
sponsored.sum: Directs the public service commission, in consultation with the New York State energy research and development authority, to create an agrivoltaics incentive program to support agrivoltaic projects designed to maximize agricultural and environmental co-benefits.

sponsored.t: Prohibits the use of the pesticide paraquat
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the distribution, sale, offer for sale, and use of any pesticide product containing paraquat dichloride or any other chemical form of paraquat.

sponsored.t: Relates to the topics of the course required to be taken by practitioners certifying patients as eligible for medical cannabis
sponsored.sum: Relates to the topics of the course required to be taken by practitioners certifying patients as eligible for medical cannabis; establishes the endocannabinoid system awareness program; requires the office of cannabis awareness and the department of health to publish information about the endocannabinoid system awareness program on their websites.

sponsored.t: Requires the commissioner of corrections and community supervision to make facility water testing results accessible to the public, incarcerated individuals and correctional facility staff
sponsored.sum: Requires the commissioner of corrections and community supervision to make correctional facility water testing results accessible directly, upon request, to incarcerated individuals and correctional facility staff in such facilities and make such water testing results available to the public on the website of the department.

sponsored.t: Relates to geothermal renewable energy credits
sponsored.sum: Establishes a tradeable geothermal renewable energy credit compliance instrument for load serving entities.

sponsored.t: Relates to issuing stop-work orders for misclassification of employees
sponsored.sum: Empowers the commissioner of labor to issue stop-work orders against employers for misclassification of employees as independent contractors or for providing false, incomplete, or misleading information to an insurance company on the number of employees of such employer.

sponsored.t: Extends certain provisions relating to supermarkets providing excess edible food to food relief organizations
sponsored.sum: Extends certain provisions relating to supermarkets providing excess edible food to food relief organizations to 12/31/2031.

sponsored.t: Designates March 25, "Medal of Honor Day", as a day of commemoration
sponsored.sum: Designates March 25, "Medal of Honor Day", as a day of commemoration.

sponsored.t: Expands geographical boundaries for residency requirements of correction officers employed by the counties of Rockland and Orange
sponsored.sum: Expands geographical boundaries for residency requirements of correction officers employed by local correction facilities of Rockland and Orange counties.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the department of environmental conservation to independently add to the lists of prohibited and regulated invasive species on an emergency basis
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the department of environmental conservation to independently add to the lists of prohibited and regulated invasive species on an emergency basis pending review by the department of agriculture and markets in consultation with the New York invasive species council.

sponsored.t: Relates to the biofuel production credit
sponsored.sum: Modifies the biofuel production credit from ethanol to renewable diesel and renewable hydrocarbon diesel.

sponsored.t: Relates to school potable water testing, and standards and requirements to install filtered water stations and faucets
sponsored.sum: Relates to school potable water testing, and standards and requirements to install filtered water stations and faucets.
sponsored.fis: New bill Funding support through the clean water infrastructure program

sponsored.t: Requires for construction activities that require a state pollutant discharge elimination system permit owners and operators to submit a copy of the required public notice
sponsored.sum: Requires for construction activities that require a state pollutant discharge elimination system permit owners and operators to submit a copy of the required public notice; requires each county receiving such notice to make such notice publicly available on its website.

sponsored.t: Designates services to be provided by a jail-based substance use disorder treatment, peer led recovery support services, and transition services program as essential medical care services
sponsored.sum: Designates services to be provided by a jail-based substance use disorder treatment, peer led recovery support services, and transition services program as essential medical care services.

sponsored.t: Enacting the lead-free game donation act
sponsored.sum: Prohibits game taken by a firearm using lead ammunition from being donated for human consumption.

sponsored.t: Directs the commissioner of the office of addiction services and supports to promulgate rules and regulations for providers operating in rural locations
sponsored.sum: Directs the commissioner of the office of addiction services and supports to promulgate rules and regulations for providers operating in rural locations while taking into account the extra challenges encountered by such providers, including but not limited to, increased and additional expenses.

sponsored.t: Establishes a right of first refusal in municipalities for state land to be sold at public auction
sponsored.sum: Establishes a right of first refusal in municipalities for state land to be sold at public auction.

sponsored.t: Designates water development representatives for each environmental region of the state
sponsored.sum: Directs DEC to designate a representative for each environmental conservation region of the state to serve as the point of contact for municipalities to aid in the acquisition of resources and funding for water projects.

sponsored.t: Relates to the reporting of lyme and tick-borne disease infection after death
sponsored.sum: Relates to the reporting of lyme and tick-borne disease infection after death.

sponsored.t: Enacts the climate resilient New York act of 2026; establishes the office of resilience to assess and identify climate related threats
sponsored.sum: Enacts the climate resilient New York act; establishes the office of resilience and a resilience task force to assess and identify climate related threats and develop a statewide resilience plan.

sponsored.t: Enacts the whale awareness act
sponsored.sum: Enacts the whale awareness act directing the department of environmental conservation to establish recommendations and educational materials for reduction of marine mammal interactions.

sponsored.t: Creates a program to assist municipalities with water quality improvement of water bodies within the municipality managed by lake associations
sponsored.sum: Creates a program to assist municipalities with water quality improvement of water bodies within the municipality managed by lake associations.

sponsored.t: Establishes the previously owned zero-emission vehicles rebate program
sponsored.sum: Establishes the previously owned zero-emission vehicles rebate program to provide an incentive of an amount up to $2,000 for individuals who purchase used or previously owned zero-emission vehicles.

sponsored.t: Relates to the payment for services at addiction treatment centers operated by the office of addiction services and supports
sponsored.sum: Requires that services at addiction treatment centers operated by the office of addiction services and supports shall not be refused at such centers if a person is unable to pay.

sponsored.t: Prohibits non-compete agreements for certain medical professionals
sponsored.sum: Prohibits non-compete agreements for certain medical professionals; authorizes covered individuals to bring a civil action in a court of competent jurisdiction against any employer or persons alleged to have violated such prohibition.

sponsored.t: Makes technical corrections relating to authorizing the Bedford Hills Fire District to file an application for exemption from school and real property taxes
sponsored.sum: Makes technical corrections relating to authorizing the Bedford Hills Fire District to file an application for exemption from school and real property taxes for the 2022-2023 assessment years.

sponsored.t: Relates to the department of environmental conservation's regulation of crabs
sponsored.sum: Extends DEC's authority to regulate management of crabs; authorizes the department of environmental conservation to take any actions necessary to ensure any quota limiting the taking of horseshoe crabs does not exceed certain thresholds.

sponsored.t: Establishes an animal abuser registry
sponsored.sum: Establishes an animal abuser registry; requires background checks for pet store and animal shelter licenses.

sponsored.t: Provides for motor fuel pollution and health impact labelling requirements
sponsored.sum: Provides for motor fuel pollution and health impact labelling requirements for retail outlets.

sponsored.t: Establishes the climate corporate data accountability act
sponsored.sum: Establishes the climate corporate data accountability act requiring certain business entities within the state to annually disclose scope 1, scope 2 and scope 3 emissions; establishes the climate accountability and emissions disclosure fund.

sponsored.t: Prohibits the sale of certain products that contain regulated perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances; and provides penalties for violations
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the sale of certain products that contain regulated perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances; requires manufacturers of products containing PFAS to provide notice of such fact to persons that offer the products for sale or distribution; provides penalties for violations.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "emission tampering act"
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the disabling, removal or interference with emission control devices and the use of emission tampering devices; provides remedies for the violation of such provisions.

sponsored.t: Relates to paper receipts and requires businesses to provide proof of purchase electronically
sponsored.sum: Relates to paper receipts and requires businesses to provide proof of purchase electronically.

sponsored.t: Establishes an instant lottery scratch-off game to fund scholarships for veterans
sponsored.sum: Establishes the veterans benefit instant lottery scratch-off game to fund scholarships for veterans through the veterans tuition awards program.

sponsored.t: Provides an exemption from requirements for the alienation of parkland for certain renewable energy generating projects
sponsored.sum: Provides an exemption from requirements for the alienation of parkland for renewable energy generating projects with a generating capacity not exceeding two megawatts and which are located above real property currently used for vehicle parking.

sponsored.t: Relates to the protection and promotion of the mental health of the residents of New York state
sponsored.sum: Requires parity in the mental and physical health treatment of the residents of New York state; provides that both mental and physical health "will be matters of public concern and provision therefor shall be made by the state and by such of its subdivisions".

sponsored.t: Relates to the creation of an ATV recreation fund and the use of ATVs
sponsored.ls: Parks, Recreation and Historic Preservation Law
sponsored.sum: Relates to the creation of an ATV recreation fund and the use of ATVs.

sponsored.t: Designates certain entities relating to the decommissioning of Indian Point state agencies for the purposes of MWBE participation
sponsored.sum: Designates certain entities relating to the decommissioning of Indian Point state agencies for the purposes of MWBE participation including the Indian Point Decommissioning Oversight Board and the Indian Point Closure Task Force.

sponsored.t: Establishes an intensive addiction and medical services integrated services pilot program
sponsored.sum: Establishes an intensive addiction and medical services integrated services pilot program to support two three-year demonstration programs that provide intensive addiction and medical services integrated services to individuals who have significant addiction and medical issues.

sponsored.t: Prohibits the diminution of retiree health benefits by a public employer
sponsored.sum: Prevents public employers from diminishing health insurance benefits provided to retirees and their dependents or the contributions such employer makes for such health insurance coverage below the level of such benefits or contributions made on behalf of such retirees and their dependents by such public employer.

sponsored.t: Directs the education department to study, review and report on the placement of the counties of Putnam and Rockland in the Hudson Valley region for purposes of public school foundation aid
sponsored.sum: Directs the education department to study, review and report on the geographic cost variation of counties in the Hudson Valley labor force region to determine the appropriateness of the region cost index values for purposes of the public school foundation aid formula.

sponsored.t: Relates to finding alternatives to the use of pesticides in the monarch preservation plan
sponsored.sum: Relates to finding alternatives to the use of pesticides in the monarch preservation plan and allowing agricultural lands that are not in active production be used to enhance the monarch butterfly habitat.

sponsored.t: Relates to requiring applications for retail gas station building permits to include electric vehicle charging stations
sponsored.sum: Requires applications for retail gas station building permits to include one electric vehicle charging station using direct current fast chargers at such gasoline station per four gas dispensing pumps.

sponsored.t: Prohibits the idling of any passenger vehicle for more than 3 consecutive minutes
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the idling of any passenger vehicle, with certain exceptions, for more than 3 consecutive minutes; establishes the first violation is a warning and subsequent violations of such section are traffic infractions punishable by a fine of $150.

sponsored.t: Relates to distinctive license plates for society for the prevention of cruelty to animals officers
sponsored.sum: Relates to distinctive license plates for society for the prevention of cruelty to animals officers.

sponsored.t: Relates to collaborative prescriptive authority for psychologists
sponsored.sum: Allows a licensed psychologist to apply to the department of education for conditional prescribing certification if the psychologist meets certain requirements; allows the department of education to waive certain requirements for an applying psychologist; provides that a conditional prescribing certification shall be valid for a period of two years.

sponsored.t: Designates unlawful discriminatory practices relating to persons recovering from substance use disorder
sponsored.sum: Relates to unlawful discriminatory practices by government agencies relating to persons recovering from substance use disorder.

sponsored.t: Includes implantable infusion pumps for chronic non-cancer pain management as standard coverage for medical assistance
sponsored.sum: Includes implantable infusion pumps for chronic non-cancer pain management as standard coverage for medical assistance.

sponsored.t: Establishes an electronic monitoring program for children diagnosed with developmental disabilities
sponsored.sum: Relates to establishing an electronic monitoring program for children diagnosed with developmental disabilities.

sponsored.t: Defines film zone and excludes the film zone from the additional empire state film production credit
sponsored.sum: Defines film zone; excludes the film zone from the additional empire state film production credit.

sponsored.t: Makes permanent provisions creating a presumption relating to certain lung disabilities incurred by volunteer firefighters
sponsored.sum: Makes permanent provisions creating a presumption relating to certain lung disabilities incurred by volunteer firefighters.

sponsored.t: Makes provisions permanent relating to disability due to disease or malfunction of the heart or coronary arteries
sponsored.sum: Makes provisions permanent relating to disability due to disease or malfunction of the heart or coronary arteries.

sponsored.t: Relates to accessing records under the freedom of information law
sponsored.sum: Provides for accessing records under the freedom of information law including notification procedures and the release of names of natural persons and residential addresses.

sponsored.t: Prohibits certain forensic child custody evaluators from appearing as an expert witness in family court
sponsored.sum: Prohibits forensic child custody evaluators who have been terminated for cause from appearing as an expert witness in family court custody and visitation proceedings.

sponsored.t: Expands the definition of tuition for children with handicapping conditions
sponsored.sum: Relates to the definition of tuition for children with handicapping conditions.

sponsored.t: Requires hospitals to provide medically supervised detoxification services
sponsored.sum: Requires hospitals to provide medically supervised detoxification services to all patients requiring such services; provides, that if the hospital is at ninety percent capacity or greater, such hospital shall connect the patient to an alternative facility within such patient's network to access such medically supervised detoxification services without any increased risk to the health or life of the patient.

sponsored.t: Establishes a retirement benefit review panel
sponsored.sum: Establishes a retirement benefit review panel.

sponsored.t: Increases the amount of residential solar tax credits
sponsored.sum: Increases the amount of residential solar tax credits.
sponsored.fis: Current law caps the solar tax credit at $5,000 or 25%, whichever is met first, per taxpayer. This bill would increase the maximum amount to $10,000 while keeping the 25% cap.

sponsored.t: Exempts innovative and alternative septic systems from sales and use taxes
sponsored.sum: Exempts innovative and alternative septic systems that provide for enhanced treatment technologies from sales and use taxes.

sponsored.t: Provides a tax exemption for certain volunteer firefighters and ambulance workers in Westchester county
sponsored.sum: Provides a tax exemption for certain volunteer firefighters and ambulance workers in Westchester county.

sponsored.t: Designates uniformed court officers in the town of Ossining, county of Westchester as peace officers
sponsored.sum: Designates uniformed court officers in the town of Ossining, county of Westchester as peace officers.
sponsored.fis: There are no fiscal implications to the State. However, there will be a cost savings to the municipality.

sponsored.t: Establishes the East of Hudson watershed road salt reduction task force, pilot plan and test program
sponsored.sum: Establishes the East of Hudson watershed road salt reduction task force, pilot plan and test program to conduct a comprehensive review of road salt contamination and road management best practices within the East of Hudson watershed.

sponsored.t: Includes certain employees or volunteers of youth organizations as mandated reporters
sponsored.sum: Includes certain employees or volunteers of not-for-profit youth organizations whose primary purpose is to interact with youth through activities, events or gatherings as mandated reporters.
sponsored.fis: There are no fiscal implications associated with the passage of this legislation.

sponsored.t: Prohibits the purchase of single-use plastic products by state agencies
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the purchase of single-use plastic products by state agencies, first limiting purchases to be used at any event, briefing, or meeting hosted or sponsored by a state agency in 2030, and a complete prohibition beginning in 2035.

sponsored.t: Directs the department of environmental conservation to establish an installation grant program and a maintenance rebate program for perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances removal treatment
sponsored.sum: Directs the department of environmental conservation to establish a perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances removal treatment installation grant program, providing a one-time grant to private well users for the installation of PFAS treatment or service connection to a public water system; directs the department of environmental conservation to establish a perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances removal treatment maintenance rebate program, providing a rebate to private well users for the maintenance of PFAS treatment equipment.

sponsored.t: Provides a period of probable usefulness for solar arrays and panels
sponsored.sum: Provides a period of probable usefulness for the acquisition, construction or reconstruction of or addition to a solar array or solar panel system, whether or not including buildings, land or rights in land, original furnishings, equipment, machinery or apparatus, or the replacement of such equipment, machinery or apparatus.

sponsored.t: Relates to the availability of opioid reversal agents
sponsored.sum: Relates to the availability of opioid reversal agents; requires the department of health to make available any formulation and dosage of opioid reversal agents approved by the federal food and drug administration.

sponsored.t: Relates to student age eligibility for certain programs and benefits
sponsored.sum: Increases age eligibility for certain programs and benefits to age twenty-two for students with a disability.

sponsored.t: Exempts first-time homebuyers from the mortgage recording tax
sponsored.sum: Exempts first-time homebuyers from the mortgage recording tax.

sponsored.t: Requires cell towers to be equipped with a back-up power source in case of a power outage
sponsored.sum: Requires cell towers to be equipped with a back-up power source in case of a power outage.

sponsored.t: Establishes a legal services veterans tax credit for attorneys who perform certain services for veterans and disabled veterans
sponsored.sum: Establishes a legal services veterans tax credit of up to $1,500 for any attorney who performs a minimum of fifty hours of pro bono legal services to a veteran or disabled veteran during a taxable year; provides that such services shall include, but not be limited to, veteran's benefits and appeals, military discharges and upgrades, public benefits, evictions and foreclosures, and consumer debt issues.

sponsored.t: Requires the addition of fog lines on all state highways, roads and other public ways under the jurisdiction of the department of transportation when repaved
sponsored.sum: Requires the addition of fog lines on all state highways and other public ways under the jurisdiction of the department of transportation when such highway or public way is repaved.

sponsored.t: Provides that a student enrolled in an individualized education program during certain school years may continue to receive educational services for a certain period
sponsored.sum: Provides that a student enrolled in an individualized education program during certain school years may continue to receive educational services until the student completes the services pursuant to the individualized education program or the end of the school year during which the student turns twenty-two years old, whichever is sooner.

sponsored.t: Expands the requirements for teaching humane education to secondary school students
sponsored.sum: Expands the requirements for teaching humane education of animals to secondary school students; requires verification of compliance.

sponsored.t: Prohibits the use of lead ammunition in the taking of wildlife on state-owned land and on land contributing surface water to the New York city water supply
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the use of lead ammunition in the taking of wildlife on wildlife management areas, state forests, forest preserves, state parks or any other state-owned land that is open for hunting and on land contributing surface water to the New York city water supply.

sponsored.t: Establishes parity in reimbursement rates for supportive stabilization services provided that are substantially equivalent to crisis stabilization center services
sponsored.sum: Establishes parity in reimbursement rates for the first twenty-four hours of supportive stabilization services provided that are substantially equivalent to crisis stabilization center services.

sponsored.t: Requires utility service providers to disclose and report third-party contracts within a certain amount of time
sponsored.sum: Requires any gas or electric provider of last resort to publicly notice each purchase of electricity supply, energy or capacity, within seven days of purchase and report it to the department.

sponsored.t: Requires the state police to have a local liaison within the New York state intelligence center who alerts municipalities of certain suspected domestic extremism threats
sponsored.sum: Requires the state police to have a local liaison within the New York state intelligence center who alerts municipalities of certain suspected domestic extremism threats and receives information from local law enforcement regarding domestic extremism.

sponsored.t: Requires certain agreements be included in the synopsis of requests for appropriations for the state budget
sponsored.sum: Requires written agreements between the governor and the legislature that relate to any budget appropriations be included in the synopsis of requests for appropriations for the state budget and published on the public website of the division of the budget.

sponsored.t: Establishes a moratorium on the use of forensic child custody evaluators in family court proceedings
sponsored.sum: Establishes a moratorium on the use of forensic child custody evaluators in family court proceedings by the office of court administration.

sponsored.t: Defines certain terms in standard form contracts as unconscionable
sponsored.sum: Defines certain terms in standard form contracts as unconscionable.

sponsored.t: Prohibits nursing homes and care facilities from denying admission to individuals receiving a controlled substance medication for a substance use disorder
sponsored.sum: Prohibits nursing homes and care facilities that are registered with the state of New York and registered with the federal Drug Enforcement Agency, that maintains a stock of, and directly dispenses, controlled substance medications from denying admission to individuals receiving a controlled substance medication for a substance use disorder.

sponsored.t: Includes certain programs and facilities in the definition of provider or provider agency
sponsored.sum: Includes organizations and programs that provide community based services to individuals under twenty-one in the definition of provider or provider agency regarding the statewide central register of child abuse and maltreatment.

sponsored.t: Prohibits health insurers from requiring prior authorization for anti-retroviral medication used to treat and prevent HIV infection
sponsored.sum: Prohibits health insurers, health care plans and HMOs from requiring prior authorization for anti-retroviral medication used to treat and prevent HIV infection.

sponsored.t: Requires health insurers to provide coverage for opioid antagonists and devices
sponsored.sum: Requires health insurers to provide coverage for opioid antagonists and devices.

sponsored.t: Exempts qualified military benefits of veterans from inclusion in a resident's adjusted gross income
sponsored.sum: Exempts qualified military benefits from inclusion in a resident's adjusted gross income, including any allowance or in-kind benefit other than personal use of a vehicle, received by any former member of the uniformed services of the United States or any dependent of such member by reason of such member's status or service as a member of such uniformed services.

sponsored.t: Requires certain SUNY and CUNY schools to establish substance use recovery housing programs
sponsored.sum: Requires SUNY and CUNY schools with at least twenty-five percent of its undergraduate students living on campus to establish substance use recovery housing programs which shall include on-site counseling, mentoring, and peer support.

sponsored.t: Relates to coverage for the screening, diagnosis and treatment of autism spectrum disorder
sponsored.sum: Relates to coverage for applied behavior analysis and for developmental, individual-differences, relationship-based treatment of autism spectrum disorder.
sponsored.fis: To be determined. The treatment of autism spectrum disorders will result in better long-term health outcomes for individuals and should therefore lessen costs.

sponsored.t: Relates to required clinical education for certain mental health practitioners
sponsored.sum: Requires clinical experience for certain mental health practitioners; allows such practitioners to make assessment-based treatment plans; makes related provisions.

sponsored.t: Provides for automatic enrollment to NY-Alert on the application for a learner's permit, driver's license, non-driver identification card, or renewal thereof
sponsored.sum: Provides for automatic enrollment to NY-Alert on the application for a learner's permit, driver's license, non-driver identification card, or renewal thereof; requires a space for an applicant to opt out of such enrollment.

sponsored.t: Requires introducer's memorandum to include a statement of fiscal impact affecting political subdivisions
sponsored.sum: Requires introducer's memorandum to include a statement of fiscal impact affecting political subdivisions.

sponsored.t: Expands the purposes of certain firefighter's benevolent associations
sponsored.sum: Permits an incorporated firefighter's benevolent association created by act of the legislature to include the following in the purposes of the association without an additional act of the legislature; to promote friendly association for the betterment of the members of the corporation; to promote relations between the members of the corporation and the local community; to provide relief, aid and assistance to those members and their families who are injured, disabled or indigent; to provide for the health and safety of the members of the corporation; to maintain suitable headquarters for the members of the corporation; to acquire real and personal property such as may be necessary for the…

sponsored.t: Relates to the delivery of services that are clinical in nature
sponsored.sum: Relates to the delivery of services that are clinical in nature by persons serving in programs under the jurisdiction of the department of mental hygiene, while under a level of supervision by a licensed professional as determined by the appropriate mental hygiene commissioner.

sponsored.t: Relates to reexamination of licensees
sponsored.sum: Permits the commissioner of motor vehicles to require any licensed driver to submit to an examination or reexamination prior to such licensed driver's normal renewal date upon receipt of a recommendation from a court having jurisdiction of traffic offenses, or the governor or chief magistrate of a state or territory stating that the driver's ability to operate a motor vehicle safely is questionable.

sponsored.t: Enacts the state and local clean energy partnership
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "state and local clean energy partnership", directing the public service commission to establish a standard New York state community choice aggregation program for all utility service territories.

sponsored.t: Relates to restricting advertisements for alcoholic beverages
sponsored.sum: Restricts advertisements for alcoholic beverages; requires an alcoholism hotline number on each advertisement; requires the State Liquor Authority to promulgate rules that require licensees to implement responsible drinking programs that include comprehensive employee trainings on responding to circumstances in which individuals present signs of alcohol abuse or suffering from the disease of alcoholism and requirements for such licensee or permit holder to assess, prevent, and address alcohol abuse by users under the age of thirty.

sponsored.t: Requires hate crime awareness curriculum or instruction for school districts
sponsored.sum: Requires hate crime awareness curriculum or instruction for school districts.

sponsored.t: Requires all state and private agencies with mandatory reporters of incidents involving vulnerable people to retrain all staff on reporting to a 9-1-1 operator and the county district attorney's office
sponsored.sum: Requires all state and private agencies with mandatory reporters of incidents involving vulnerable people to retrain all staff on reporting to a 9-1-1 operator and the county district attorney's office and state and private websites; requires written materials to be updated.

sponsored.t: Provides for administration of certain funds for zero-emission school buses and supporting infrastructure
sponsored.sum: Provides for administration of certain funds for zero-emission school buses and supporting infrastructure by NYSERDA.

sponsored.t: Relates to establishing a model neurodiversity awareness training program
sponsored.sum: Directs the department of labor, in consultation with the division of human rights and the department of health to produce a model training program on neurodiversity awareness.

sponsored.t: Requires a candidate for office to file additional information about the candidate's educational background, military service history, and employment history
sponsored.sum: Requires a candidate for office to file additional information about the candidate's educational background, military service history, and employment history; provides penalties for violations.

sponsored.t: Establishes certified recovery residences for individuals recovering from substance use disorder
sponsored.sum: Establishes certified recovery residences for individuals recovering from substance use disorder; provides for state aid and municipal site approval.

sponsored.t: Provides for a pilot solicitation of climate leadership and community protection act projects relating to wind energy in Lake Erie and requirements therefor
sponsored.sum: Provides for a pilot project in furtherance of climate leadership and community protection act clean energy standards in Lake Erie; establishes standards for wind energy procured therefrom.

sponsored.t: Establishes an agrivoltaic production tax credit
sponsored.sum: Establishes an agrivoltaic production tax credit for farmers who manage a farm operation that is situated wholly or in part within one or more qualified agrivoltaic facilities.

sponsored.t: Expands participation in the New York state secure choice savings program
sponsored.sum: Expands participation in the New York state secure choice savings program.
sponsored.fis: Increased revenue for surrogate courts through new higher fee brackets in the fee schedule.

sponsored.t: Establishes the water resiliency projects fund; appropriation
sponsored.sum: Establishes the water resiliency projects fund for flood mitigation, stormwater mitigation and other water related resiliency projects; makes an appropriation therefor.

sponsored.t: Provides for tax credit for the adoption of pets from animal shelter
sponsored.sum: Provides for tax credit for the adoption of pets from an animal shelter up to $250 per pet.

sponsored.t: Directs the New York state energy research and development authority to take certain actions to increase awareness for geothermal energy systems
sponsored.sum: Directs the New York state energy research and development authority to develop basic consumer education or guidance about geothermal energy systems and develop business models for geothermal projects in the state to match equivalent programming and guidance for solar energy.

sponsored.t: Requires certain public residential buildings to maintain a supply of naloxone
sponsored.sum: Requires public residential buildings that receive funding through the department of housing and urban development or the division of housing and community renewal to have a supply of at least one dose of naloxone readily accessible for residential use as provided by OASAS.

sponsored.t: Relates to recordkeeping requirements for second-hand dealers and pawnbrokers
sponsored.sum: Provides for electronic recordkeeping requirements for second-hand dealers and pawnbrokers.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "all electric ATVs act of 2025"
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "all electric ATVs act"; requires a study to be conducted on the feasibility of installing electric ATV charging stations along all state-maintained trails where use of ATVs is permitted, with the goal to have 100% all electric ATVs within the state by 2035; increases the weight limit of ATVs to 2 thousand pounds dry weight; amends fee schedules for registration of ATVs; directs a portion of funds collected from registration of electric ATVs to be donated to the federal EPA.

sponsored.t: Establishes the New York state energy storage siting task force
sponsored.sum: Establishes the New York state energy storage siting task force to review the findings and recommendations of the Inter-Agency Fire Safety Working Group, summarize other current data and research and provide recommendations including any recommendations for where more data may be required.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "Great Swamp Protection Act"
sponsored.sum: Creates the "Great Swamp protection act" for lands in Dutchess and Putnam counties.

sponsored.t: Provides for consumer protection and utility meter choice
sponsored.sum: Establishes certain consumer rights for the protection of consumer health, safety and/or privacy needs related to utility meters.

sponsored.t: Exempts school buses from central business district tolls
sponsored.sum: Exempts school buses from central business district tolls.

sponsored.t: Relates to establishing a mollusk shell recycling tax credit
sponsored.sum: Establishes a mollusk shell recycling tax credit; directs DEC to promulgate necessary regulations.

sponsored.t: Relates to establishing a school safety spending exclusion from annual tax levy limits
sponsored.sum: Provides an annual tax levy limit allowing for expenditures directly or indirectly related to school safety, including improving district wide emergency response plans, training staff and/or students on school safety and/or conflict mediation, installing and maintaining safety technology and software in school buildings, hiring school resource officers, acquiring emergency medical equipment, installing fencing around the perimeter of school grounds, installing bulletproof doors and windows, acquiring and maintaining technology for expedited notification of local law enforcement during an emergency.

sponsored.t: Relates to providing water utilities with access to water quality infrastructure improvement funding
sponsored.sum: Relates to providing water utilities with access to water quality infrastructure improvement funding.

sponsored.t: Relates to setting minimum reimbursement for mobile crisis intervention services
sponsored.sum: Sets the reimbursement for mobile crisis intervention services to be a rate that is not less than the rate that would be paid for such services pursuant to the medical assistance program under title eleven of article five of the social services law.

sponsored.t: Requires the office of mental health to conduct a study on utilizing the therapeutic techniques studied by the research and recognition project for the treatment of post-traumatic stress disorder
sponsored.sum: Requires the office of mental health to conduct a study on utilizing the therapeutic techniques studied by the research and recognition project for the treatment of post-traumatic stress disorder.

sponsored.t: Relates to minimum staffing levels for agencies enforcing the minimum standards under the New York State Uniform Fire Prevention and Building Code Act
sponsored.sum: Relates to the content of rules and regulations to be promulgated by the Secretary of State with respect to minimum staffing levels for agencies enforcing the minimum standards under the New York State Uniform Fire Prevention and Building Code Act.

sponsored.t: Clarifies certain provisions related to prohibiting plastic carryout bags
sponsored.sum: Clarifies certain provisions related to prohibiting plastic carryout bags.

sponsored.t: Enacts the beekeeping rights act
sponsored.sum: Enacts the beekeeping rights act to prohibit homeowners' associations from adopting or enforcing any rules or regulations that would effectively prohibit, or impose unreasonable limitations on, the installation or use of an apiary.

sponsored.t: Establishes the crimes of assault on a child protective services worker, aggravated assault on a child protective services worker and menacing a child protective services worker
sponsored.sum: Establishes the crimes of assault on a child protective services worker, aggravated assault on a child protective services worker and menacing a child protective services worker.

sponsored.t: Provides for distinctive plates for gold star families
sponsored.sum: Provides for distinctive plates for gold star families, including gold star parents, as defined in 10 USC 1126, or children of a gold star parent, and their spouses.

sponsored.t: Directs the department of public service, in conjunction with other agencies to commission a study on the utilization of directional noise reduction optimization technology for wind turbines in New York state
sponsored.sum: Directs the department of public service, in conjunction with the New York state energy research and development authority, and the power authority of the state of New York to commission a study on the utilization of directional noise reduction optimization technology for wind turbines in New York state.

sponsored.t: Relates to smart growth public infrastructure criteria
sponsored.sum: Expands smart growth public infrastructure criteria to apply to the New York State urban development corporation; adds the additional criteria of promoting public transit ridership and ensuring existing transit riders are able to access employment opportunities and cultural and recreational amenities with ease through the construction of transit facilities protected from extreme weather and traffic violence less than one quarter of a mile walking distance to such opportunities and amenities.

sponsored.t: Establishes a speed zone camera demonstration program in the village of Mount Kisco
sponsored.sum: Establishes a speed zone camera demonstration program in the village of Mount Kisco; repeals authorization of program December 31, 2030.

sponsored.t: Requires human safety operators for certain autonomous vehicles
sponsored.sum: Prohibits any motor vehicle with a manufacturers' gross vehicle weight rating of ten thousand one pounds or more which utilizes autonomous vehicle technology from being operated on public highways unless a natural person holding a valid license for the operation of the motor vehicle's class is present within such vehicle.

sponsored.t: Incentivizes projects on certain Brownfield sites
sponsored.sum: Incentivizes projects on certain Brownfield sites through enhanced tax credits.

sponsored.t: Relates to protection of certain potable water supplies
sponsored.sum: Improves protection of certain potential inter-municipal water supplies located in impoundments in the course of a stream.

sponsored.t: Relates to the selection of tenants in state aided housing projects in the county of Westchester
sponsored.sum: Permits the county of Westchester to grant a fifty percent preference in the selection of tenants in state aided housing projects to current residents of the county.

sponsored.t: Relates to the appointment of certain police officers
sponsored.sum: Provides that the maximum age requirement of 35 years for police officers to take a competitive examination shall not apply to any police officer of any county, city, town or village police force not otherwise provided for in this section if such officer is a part-time police officer in a non-competitive position and is vested in the New York state and local police and fire retirement system.

sponsored.t: Relates to siting permits for grassland bird breeding habitats or grassland bird wintering habitats
sponsored.sum: Requires a mitigation ratio of three acres of mitigation for every acre of occupied grassland bird breeding habitat and one acre of mitigation for every acre of grassland bird wintering habitat included in a major electric transmission facility siting permit.

sponsored.t: Relates to extending the exemption of certain chemicals used in mattresses from regulation for an additional year
sponsored.sum: Extends an exemption relating to the use of certain chemicals used in mattresses from regulation for an additional year.

sponsored.t: Relates to the operation of amusement devices
sponsored.sum: Requires amusement device operators to be at least 16 years old, trained in the use and function of all normal and emergency operating controls, and the proper use of the amusement device; requires the operator to be in the immediate vicinity of the main control panel during operation of the amusement device; prohibits operators from operating more than one device at a time.

sponsored.t: Relates to protecting people from civil arrest while going to, remaining at, or returning from polling places
sponsored.sum: Exempts certain people from civil arrest while going to, remaining at, or returning from a polling place.

sponsored.t: Requires the metropolitan transportation authority to install solar canopies on its parking facilities
sponsored.sum: Requires the metropolitan transportation authority to install solar canopies on its parking facilities.

sponsored.t: Relates to joint certification of certified community behavioral health clinics
sponsored.sum: Provides for administrative review when applying for an additional certification by applicants to become certified community behavioral health clinics if such applicant is already certified by either the department of mental health or the office of addiction services and supports and is in good standing for five or more years.

sponsored.t: Requires the state university of New York to install solar canopies on its campuses
sponsored.sum: Requires the state university of New York to install solar canopies on its campuses.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the Bedford Hills Fire District to file an application for exemption from school and real property taxes
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the Bedford Hills Fire District to file an application for exemption from school and real property taxes for the 2022-2023 assessment years.
